attempts.summary: Configured root's crontab on node1 to run /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15, appending output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. The script file was originally corrupted (leftover heredoc/provisioning text, not executable), so it was rewritten and made executable before scheduling. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured a healthy baseline, issued a native reboot, confirmed the boot ID changed, and verified cron, the crontab entry, script permissions, and the log all persisted and functioned correctly post-reboot.
